prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1253; do not mention it.)
text:
This office has been retained to represent our client in connection with a collision that occurred when the other vehicle, insured under your policy, struck our client's vehicle while our client was making a left turn. Our client sustained significant injuries as a result of this incident and is currently receiving medical treatment.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already made contact with our client, please let us know immediately.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy in force at the time of the accident, along with a certified copy of the declarations page. We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident, including photographs, recorded statements, telematics or event data, repair and appraisal records, claim file materials, and any video or dashcam footage.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
